title: Vampire Vape Desserts Pistachio Milkshake Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Pistachio Milkshake Flavour Concentrate by Vampire Vape Desserts offers a luxurious blend of roasted Pistachio flavour stirred through a smooth, velvety Milkshake base. This indulgent concentrate captures the nutty richness of Pistachio, mellowed by the cool creaminess of a classic milkshake drink, for an expertly layered and comforting flavour profile. Designed for DIY e-liquid mixing, this 30ml concentrate must be diluted before use. Simply blend with your preferred VG/PG base and nicotine shots if desired. Vampire Vape recommends a dilution rate of 15–20%, depending on how strong you like your flavours. Made in the UK and formulated with a 100% PG base, Pistachio Milkshake is not suitable for direct vaping. Also available as a 10ml Freebase e-liquid and a high-VG Shortfill as part of the Vampire Vape Desserts collection.
